subject: Mutual Action Plan & Pilot -> Pricing & Renewal Uplift
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@quantummedtech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@quantummedtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

Hi Emily / QMT procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (QMT-MAP-v1.0.pdf) and a proposed evaluation schedule to get the pilot moving next week. Key highlights:

- Pilot kickoff: 2026-05-20 (3-week integration & baseline)
- Evaluation metrics: latency p95, throughput for throughput-critical pipelines, quality checks (F1 on label set)
- Ramp/commit milestones: convert to committed capacity by 2026-08-01 with 3-tier commit thresholds (pilot -> 50% ramp -> full commit)
- Pricing: pilot discounted rate, conversion pricing tied to commit band (sheet attached)
- Renewal/expansion: we propose a re-commit checkpoint at 9 months with an uplift negotiation window (see section 4 of the MAP). Uplift framework is tiered by committed RU/day; we can cap uplift or negotiate a multi-year fixed schedule.

Can you confirm the MAP dates and whether procurement wants an extended evaluation beyond the 3-week integration? If those look reasonable, I’ll loop in legal to prep an SOW and Ben will confirm promo approval for pilot pricing.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: QMT-MAP-v1.0.pdf
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@quantummedtech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@quantummedtech.com>, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@quantummedtech.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the clear MAP. A couple quick asks from our side before we sign off:

1) Procurement would like the evaluation window extended to 6 weeks total (2 weeks integration + 4 weeks measurement) to ensure our clinical QA team can run the label verification. Is that possible?
2) On pricing: what uplift should we expect at renewal? Our CFO wants a predictable ceiling if usage scales quickly.
3) If we agree to a 12-month commit after the pilot, can you provide a discount schedule for multi-year renewal?

Looping in Daniel (CTO) for technical sign-off. If procurement approves the extended window, we’ll target a kickoff the week of 5/25.

Best,
Emily
Head of Partnerships | Quantum MedTech
emily.carter@quantummedtech.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@quantummedtech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@quantummedtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

Emily — thanks, all fair asks. Short answers:

1) Evaluation window: yes — we can move to a 6-week evaluation (2+4). That shifts the conversion target to 2026-08-15 to give you the full measurement window.

2) Renewal uplift: we propose two options in the attached pricing_sheet_qmt.xlsx:
   - Option A (predictable cap): 6% uplift cap year-over-year on base unit price for single-year renewals; 10% cap for multi-year renegotiation triggers (with fixed escalator schedule if elected).
   - Option B (usage-tiered): tiered uplift tied to RU/day bands (0-10k, 10k-50k, 50k+) with negotiated ceilings per band.

3) Multi-year discount: standard is 8-12% off committed unit price for a 2-year commit; 13-20% for 3-year depending on volume. For the pilot -> commit path we can offer a limited 10% pilot-to-commit conversion credit if signed within 30 days of pilot completion.

Ben — can you confirm we can apply the 10% pilot conversion credit and the 90-day promo code for onboarding? Laura — can you draft a short SOW that matches the MAP dates if QMT signs?

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments: pricing_sheet_qmt.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

All,

We can approve the 10% pilot-to-commit conversion credit and provide a 90-day onboarding promo code for the pilot. Promo code: REDWOOD-QMT-90. Please note this promo is only valid if the SOW is signed and the PO is issued within 30 days of pilot completion.

Marissa — FYI, this is within our promotional band but if QMT requests deeper concession at renewal we should pre-agree to an escalation path (sales leader approval).

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment referenced: promo_90day_code.txt
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

Soojin — drafting SOW and I will include:
- Pilot scope and acceptance criteria mapped to the evaluation metrics in the MAP
- Payment terms for initial onboarding invoice (net 30)
- Renewal/uptick language: recommend we include a negotiated uplift window at the 9-month checkpoint with an option for QMT to elect a multi-year fixed-price schedule. I’ll also add a cap clause: uplift cannot exceed 12% for the first renewal unless both parties agree in writing.

I will circulate the SOW draft by end of day Friday. Also adding HubSpot link and preliminary DocuSign envelope so tracking is in CRM.

Laura
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@quantummedtech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@quantummedtech.com>
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@quantummedtech.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantum MedTech MAP + pilot timeline proposal

Soojin / team — thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed the MAP and the adjusted 6-week evaluation is acceptable. QMT accepts the 10% pilot-to-commit conversion credit and the REDWOOD-QMT-90 onboarding promo for the pilot.

Next steps from our side: we will sign the SOW when Laura sends it, issue a PO for the onboarding fee, and target a pilot kickoff on Monday 2026-05-25. Our procurement team will send the PO and signed PO attached once internal approvals are complete.

Regards,
Emily

Attachment: QMT_signed_PO.pdf
